title: LessonOutline
description: Pedagogical outline generated by LLM and approved by teacher before slide generation

targetAudience.description: Target learner profile (e.g. Sinh viên đại học năm 1, Học sinh THPT)

estimatedDurationMinutes.description: Estimated total lecture presentation duration in minutes

learningObjectives.description: Pedagogical learning objectives (Chuẩn đầu ra bài học)

slides.description: Planned slides with recommended template and structured draft content

summary.description: Final synthesis and key takeaways of the whole lecture

slideId.description: Stable unique ID for the slide (e.g. slide-01)

suggestedLayoutId.description: Suggested layout identifier from the selected template pack

suggestedTemplateId.description: Suggested pedagogical template identifier (v1 alias or layoutId)

keyTakeaways.description: Core bullets or concepts to display

speakerNotesDraft.description: Draft Vietnamese spoken lecture narration for TTS

contentPayload.description: Template-specific fields (e.g. comparison columns, timeline steps, formula parts)
